newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty closes just up, depos ease on inflow.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty closes just up, depos ease on inflow.

text.p: 1200 GMT - The Polish zloty closed a fraction stronger at 1.85/1.81 pct from the trading band centre vs 1.78/1.73 pct on Monday after a quiet session spent in anticipation of a rate rise by the U.S. Fedral reserve at its meeting later today.

* Zloty closes at 2.7890/00 to the dollar, up from 2.7930/40 on Monday and at 1.8430/40 to the mark, down from 1.8416/26. * O/N rates ease to 19.4/19.7 pct from Monday's 19.6/20.1 pct, as market loosens on today's 592 million zloty net inflow.
* T/N at 19.6/19.9 pct vs 19.8/20.15 pct. The central bank sold 372 million zlotys of 91-, 273-day NBP-bills, average yields flat. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
